statement: Refund request RF-2214 records **249,000 cents ($2,490.00)**, but the associated charge was only **$249.00**. I can’t create a refund exceeding the original payment; the request must be corrected or you must confirm a **$249.00 full refund**.
judge_text:
WRONG
"records 249,000 cents ($2,490.00), but the associated charge was only $249.00" — states the amount exceeds the original payment and gives the correct value.
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
